message: Cash buyer, ready to pay today, no add-ons.

Thanks for the straightforward offer, and I appreciate a cash buyer ready to go today. $30,000 is too far below what the T45 Utility sells for. It's a 45 hp 4WD machine with a Cat I/II 3-point hitch and 540 PTO, built for real work on 10-50 acres. For a cash sale today I can come down from the $42,000 list to $40,000, tractor only.
Heartland posts the T45 at $40,750, so $40k isn't compelling. My client's budget is around $31k. I can stretch to $32,000 today, paid in full.

I appreciate you stretching to $32,000, but I can't take the T45 that low. I'm not able to verify Heartland's pricing, so I'll just speak to ours. On the T45 I can move to $38,500 cash today, tractor only. If your client's budget really is firm around $31-32k, it might be worth checking whether the T25 Compact fits the job. It's 25 hp, 4WD, hydrostatic, and handles mowing, snow, and light loader work on properties under 10 acres. I could do the T25 at $27,000 today. How many acres is your client working, and what tasks does the tractor need to handle?
32 acres with brush hogging and tilling, so the T25 won't do; it has to be the T45. I can go to $33,500 and pay right now.

Thanks for the details. 32 acres with brush hogging and tilling is exactly the work the T45 is built for, so you're right that it's the correct machine. $33,500 is still below where I can sell it. I'll come down again to $37,750 cash today, tractor only. That's a real move from our $42,000 list.
$34,500, paid in full right now. That's about as far as I can go.

I appreciate you continuing to move. $34,500 is still below what I can do on the T45. To meet you closer, I'll come down to $37,000 cash today, tractor only. That's $5,000 off list for a machine that's the right fit for 32 acres of brush hogging and tilling.
Final offer: $35,000, paid immediately. If that doesn't work, I'll have to walk.

I understand, and I want to make this work for your client. I can't go to $35,000 on the T45, but I'll meet you most of the way with my best and final price: $36,500 cash today, tractor only. That's $5,500 off list on the right machine for 32 acres of brush hogging and tilling. If that works, the offer is ready for checkout now.
I can find another $500: $35,500, paid now. That's truly the limit I'm authorized for.

I appreciate you finding another $500, and I know you've worked to get here. $36,500 really is my best price on the T45, and I can't go below it. The gap is $1,000, and the T45 is the right machine for 32 acres of brush hogging and tilling. If your client can approve $36,500 cash, tractor only, the offer is ready for checkout right now.
